subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Dig up dirt

options.text: To uncover negative information about someone or something.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Dig up dirt"** means to uncover or find negative information about someone or something. (किसी के बारे में नकारात्मक जानकारी खोजना) • **Example:** The journalist was determined to dig up dirt on the politician before the election. • It often refers to investigating past actions or secrets that could harm someone's reputation. (किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को नुकसान पहुंचाने वाली जानकारी की खोज) • Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom is **Option 1**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2:** Find and disclose evidence. (सबूत ढूंढना और उजागर करना) • **Example:** The detective worked tirelessly to find and disclose evidence related to the case. • **Option 3:** Enquire about a missing person. (किसी लापता व्यक्ति के बारे में पूछताछ करना) • **Example:** The police started enquiring about the missing person after receiving the report. • **Option 4:** Hide and protect vital evidence. (महत्वपूर्ण सबूत छिपाना और बचाना) • **Example:** The criminal tried to hide and protect vital evidence from the investigators. 2f:Tb61, The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Greedy)**.
